scope: Six planned scenarios for the motion graphics and sound route: the choice between a generator prompt and a finished MP4 from code, rendering where code runs, the improvement round, sound for a rendered motion video, a contract revision and a supplied external reel. No host run, rendered video or listening result is asserted.
execution_rule: Run each case in a fresh attributed session on the stated tools; save the transcript, every delivered file with its hash, the critique and timing summaries actually produced, and the reviewer's decision separately. Source checks do not execute these cases.

cases.user_request: Zrób 15-sekundowy film promocyjny mojej aplikacji do nauki słówek. Mam trzy zrzuty ekranu.
cases.expected_branch: one short choice between a prompt for a video generator and a finished MP4 built from code with the screenshots
checks: Both routes are named in one short choice; the code route says it delivers a finished MP4 here
The device scene with the user's screenshots is proposed for the code route
No generator is called and no video is claimed before the choice
forbidden: Routing silently to generator prompts only
A long intake form before the choice
required_evidence: Package version, host, client and reasoning setting
Actual input and full response transcript
Independent reviewer decision; no PASS from fixture existence

cases.user_request: Animowany napis „Jesień w mieście” na 6 sekund, pionowo 9:16, spokojnie. Daj gotowe MP4.
cases.expected_branch: contract, Python renderer copied byte for byte, critique with an improvement round, MP4 delivered
checks: The contract is shown as a storyboard table, not raw JSON
The MP4 has the contract's size, frame rate and frame count; the render script and contract are delivered with it
The critique runs before delivery; the score before and after is stated
The video is silent and sound is offered once after delivery
forbidden: A self-written exporter or MediaRecorder page instead of the renderer
required_evidence: Package version, host, client and reasoning setting
Full transcript and the delivered files with hashes

cases.user_request: W tej animacji tekst końcowy jest za krótko na ekranie i ucieka za krawędź. Popraw.

assets: delivered contract and render script from the previous turn

cases.expected_branch: revision from the existing contract, re-render, critique; at most two repair rounds
checks: Only the requested scene changes; earlier frames stay identical
The revision is numbered and the request is quoted as evidence
An error still present after the second repair is named, not hidden
forbidden: Rebuilding the whole video from scratch
required_evidence: Both revisions of the contract and the critique summaries

cases.user_request: Dodaj muzykę i dźwięki do tej animacji, którą właśnie zrobiłeś.
cases.expected_branch: motion-sound: analyse, plan, mix; timing status checked; MP4 with AAC delivered
checks: Studio designs the sound itself with sound.py instead of writing a prompt for an external tool
The cue table and the reasons for the design are stated in two or three lines
The mix's timing status is reported as checked with the number of cues judged
The user is asked to listen once with the picture
forbidden: Saying Studio has no sound engine
Toy tones or untreated oscillator beeps
Calling a partly judged timing on time
required_evidence: The delivered MP4 and the mix summary

cases.user_request: Wydłuż ostatnią scenę o sekundę, resztę zostaw.
cases.expected_branch: revise.mjs extend rule: later cues move, sound design marked stale and planned again with the user's choices kept
checks: Only the last scene and everything after it move; earlier frames are unchanged
The sound is planned again before mixing; a stale design is not mixed
forbidden: Changing copy, colours or other scenes

cases.user_request: Mam gotową 20-sekundową rolkę nagraną telefonem. Zaplanuj do niej muzykę i efekty.

assets: supplied phone video without a motion contract

cases.expected_branch: picture-first audio plan from the actual cuts; no claim that the code sound engine renders a track without a motion contract
checks: Cuts and actions are measured or asked for; tempo is not invented
The plan says which tools could render the track and what is planned versus measured
forbidden: Claiming a rendered or mixed track
Inventing the edit's tempo from its duration
